items.title: A morphism is a gerbe exactly when both it and its diagonal are surjective, flat and of finite presentation
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project — Morphisms of Algebraic Stacks
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file stacks-morphisms.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that a morphism of algebraic stacks is a gerbe if and only if both the morphism and its diagonal are surjective, flat and locally of finite presentation (author proposition at source lines 6519-6529, label proposition-when-gerbe-over). The proof (source lines 6531-6566) derives the two clauses of the gerbe condition from the two sets of properties in the forward direction and invokes the gerbe results of this chapter, including the lemma on the diagonal of a gerbe, in the converse (proof lines 6531-6565). The translation between the gerbe condition and the two sets of properties is the substance. H3.
